speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To understand what is causing these symptoms, tell me: when did these problems first start, and do you have trouble swallowing or regurgitating your food?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The onset of feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, and specifically the worsening of crying upon abdominal palpation (suggestive of peritoneal irritation) is highly concerning for this condition. I am requesting immediate imaging to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray.
